question: How many days do I have to return an item?
answer: You can return an item within 21 days of its delivery date. The delivery date is the date shown as "Delivered" in your order history; if the carrier recorded no delivery date, the window starts 7 days after the order date. This 21-day window applies to all orders placed on Albert's Marketplace across all six countries we deliver to.

question: How much does it cost to return an item I simply changed my mind about?
answer: A return for any reason other than a defect costs €3.95, which is deducted from your refund. This covers the prepaid label and is the same for every carrier and every country. Alternatively, you can send the item back at your own expense using a tracked service, in which case you pay nothing to us.

question: Can I return a mascara I have opened?
answer: No, you cannot return an opened mascara under normal circumstances. For reasons of hygiene and health, make-up products like mascaras cannot be returned once their seal has been broken or packaging opened. However, there is one exception: if the mascara is defective, damaged on arrival, not as described, or caused a confirmed reaction, you can return it within 21 days even if opened, and the return shipping will be free.

question: My parcel is 3 days past its estimated delivery date. What can I do?
answer: Your parcel is now considered late. You can cancel the order from your order history and receive a full refund, including the delivery cost, within 5 business days—you don't need to wait for the parcel to arrive. If the parcel arrives after you've cancelled it, you can refuse it or send it back using the prepaid label we'll email you.

question: Which carriers deliver to Belgium?
answer: All four of Albert's Marketplace carriers deliver to Belgium: Albatros Parcels, Blue Heron Logistics, Kestrel Freight, and Swift Otter Delivery. You cannot choose which carrier will be used for your parcel, as each seller selects the carrier for their shipment.

question: Is delivery free for a €30 order?
answer: No, delivery is not free for a €30 order. Delivery is free only for orders of €35 or more per seller. For orders below €35, delivery costs €4.90 per seller in every country.

question: Can I pay by bank transfer?
answer: No, Albert's Marketplace accepts payment by card only: Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. Bank transfers are not accepted.

question: How long after I close my account is my data deleted?
answer: When you close your account, your personal data is deleted within 30 days. However, some data is kept longer because the law requires it: invoices and payment records are kept for 10 years.

question: What commission does a seller pay on each sale?
answer: Sellers pay a commission of 12% of the item price on each sale, excluding delivery costs.

question: Is the KAO Nivea UV sunscreen gel suitable for oily skin?
answer: Yes, the KAO Nivea UV Deep Protect & Care Gel SPF 50+ is suitable for oily skin. It is a light sunscreen gel that leaves no white cast, making it an appropriate choice for oily skin types.

question: Combien coûte un retour si j'ai simplement changé d'avis ?
answer: Un retour parce que vous avez changé d'avis coûte 3,95 €, qui sera déduit de votre remboursement. Ce frais couvre l'étiquette prépayée et est identique pour tous les transporteurs et tous les pays. Vous pouvez aussi envoyer l'article à vos propres frais avec un service suivi ; dans ce cas, vous ne nous payez rien.

question: What is the phone number of customer service?
answer: Albert's Marketplace does not provide a phone number for customer service. Customers contact sellers through Albert's Marketplace only. If you have questions about your data, you can write to the data protection officer at privacy@albertsmarketplace.example.

question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
answer: I don't have information about gift wrapping services at Albert's Marketplace. For details about this service, please contact our customer support team through the help centre.

question: How long is a password reset link valid?
answer: A password reset link is valid for 1 hour. You can request a reset link using the 'Forgot password' option on the sign-in page.

question: Can I use two discount codes on the same order?
answer: No, you can only use one discount code per order.

question: Do you deliver to Switzerland?
expected_facts: not deliver|don't deliver|does not deliver|do not deliver
answer: Non, Albert's Marketplace ne livre pas en Suisse. Nous livrons uniquement dans six pays : la France, l'Allemagne, l'Italie, l'Espagne, les Pays-Bas et la Belgique.

question: How much does delivery cost for a €20 order?
answer: Delivery costs €4.90 for orders under €35. Since your order is €20, you will pay €4.90 for delivery, and this cost will be shown before you complete your payment.

question: My parcel has shown no movement for 12 days. What can I do?
answer: Since your parcel has shown no movement for 10 days or more, it is considered lost. You can report it from your order page, and we will refund you within 5 business days or send a replacement if the seller has stock, depending on what you choose.

question: How long do I have to report a parcel that arrived damaged?
answer: You have 48 hours from delivery to report a damaged parcel. Please report it with a photo of the parcel as it was delivered and a photo of the damaged item.

question: Can I change the delivery address once my order is in transit?
expected_facts: no longer|cannot be changed|can't be changed|contact the carrier
answer: No, you cannot change the delivery address once your order is in transit. You can only change the address while the order is still Processing. Once the carrier has the parcel and it is In transit, the address can no longer be changed by us or by the seller. In this case, you should contact the carrier directly with your tracking number.

question: How quickly am I refunded once my return is confirmed?
answer: Once your return is confirmed, you are refunded within 5 business days to the card you paid with. Your bank may take a few more days to show the refund in your account.

question: I was charged twice. When will the second charge be refunded?
answer: If both charges appear as collected on your statement after 3 business days, you can report the double charge from your order page with a screenshot of your statement, and we will refund the second charge within 3 business days of your report.

question: Which cards do you accept?
answer: Albert's Marketplace accepts payment by card only: Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. We do not accept bank transfers, cash on delivery, cheques, or gift cards from other shops.

question: How often are sellers paid?
answer: Sellers on Albert's Marketplace are paid every 14 days by bank transfer. The payout includes every order that was delivered at least 7 days before the payout date, minus commissions, subscription fees, and refunds. If a payout is below €10, it is carried over to the next payout period.

question: What monthly subscription does a seller with 60 sales in a month pay?
answer: A seller with 60 sales in a month pays a monthly subscription of €19.

question: Within how many days must a seller ship an order?
answer: According to Albert's Marketplace policy, sellers must ship every order within 2 business days of the order being placed.

question: How many drops of the OZNaturals Retinol Serum should I apply?
answer: You should apply two or three drops of the OZNaturals Retinol Serum in the evening on clean, dry skin, then follow with a moisturiser. It is recommended to start with two evenings a week and use a sunscreen the next day.

question: Combien de temps ai-je pour retourner un article ?
answer: Vous avez 21 jours à partir de la date de livraison indiquée dans votre historique de commandes pour retourner un article. Si le transporteur n'a pas enregistré de date de livraison, la période de retour commence 7 jours après la date de commande. Une demande de retour envoyée le 21e jour est acceptée, même si le colis arrive au vendeur plus tard.

question: Kann ich per Überweisung bezahlen?
answer: Nein, Albert's Marketplace akzeptiert nur Kartenzahlungen: Visa, Mastercard und American Express. Banküberweisung, Nachnahme, Schecks oder Geschenkkarten von anderen Shops werden nicht akzeptiert.

question: Do you have a loyalty points programme?
answer: I don't have information about a loyalty points programme at Albert's Marketplace. This isn't covered in our available policies and information.
